/* EmployeeMapper.findEmployeeProfileList */ SELECT a.id AS employeeId, a.employee_code, a.employee_role, a.employee_name, b.position_code, b.position_name, d.department_code, d.department_name, c.team_code, c.team_name, e.phone, e.email, a.created_by, f.employee_name AS createdEmployeeName, a.updated_by, g.employee_name AS updatedEmployeeName, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted_at FROM employee.profile a LEFT JOIN employee.position b ON a.position_id = b.id LEFT JOIN employee.team c ON a.team_id = c.id LEFT JOIN employee.department d ON c.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN auth.account e ON a.id = e.id LEFT JOIN employee.profile f ON a.created_by = f.id LEFT JOIN employee.profile g ON a.updated_by = g.id ORDER BY
b.position_code DESC, a.employee_code DESC, d.department_code DESC, a.created_at DESC
d.department_code DESC, a.employee_code DESC, b.position_code DESC, a.created_at DESC
a.employee_code DESC, b.position_code DESC, d.department_code DESC, a.created_at DESC
b.position_code ASC, a.employee_code ASC, d.department_code ASC, a.created_at ASC
d.department_code ASC, a.employee_code ASC, b.position_code ASC, a.created_at ASC
a.employee_code ASC, b.position_code ASC, d.department_code ASC, a.created_at ASC
OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * #{size} FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
